note: Personal-assistant job whose first task is buying gift cards.
text:
Hello,

I am Dr. Richard Hale, a professor relocating for research, and I need a part-time personal assistant for $400 per week. Your first task: purchase three $100 Apple gift cards for a client meeting, scratch the back, and email me photos of the codes. I will reimburse you with your first payment.

Dr. Richard Hale
prof.richardhale@gmail.com
